However, BOTH drop monitor agents are FAILING with exit code 126 (Operation not permitted). Logs show: 'shell-init: error retrieving current directory: getcwd: cannot access parent directories: Operation not permitted' and '/bin/bash: .../run_drop_monitor.sh: Operation not permitted'.
